'''Vachir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He worked at [[The Pit (arena)|the Pit]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], providing [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] players with [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] and other items.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vachir first appeared in the Huttball warzone on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
